paper.title: Broken-Symmetry Ground States of the Heisenberg model on the Pyrochlore Lattice
paper.authors: Nikita Astrakhantsev, Tom Westerhout, Apoorv Tiwari, Kenny Choo, Ao Chen, Mark H. Fischer, Giuseppe Carleo, Titus Neupert

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg model on the pyrochlore lattice, Eq. (1) at lambda = 1, j2 = 0 (H = j1 sum S_i · S_j with spin operators), j1 = 1, periodic 4 x 2^3 cluster.
results.source_location: Appendix, table of energies and singlet-triplet gaps, row 4 x 2^3, column NQS CNN
results.eligibility_evidence: Appendix table of ground-state energies (Table V, label tab:energies_spingaps), column 'NQS CNN': energy per site of the convolutional neural-network state with symmetry projections, optimized and evaluated by VMC in this work. The table lists DMRG and ED separately.
results.notes: Energy per site in spin units (S = sigma/2), as printed. The paper states that the mVMC error bars are statistical; the meaning of the NQS error bar is not stated.

results.system_description: Spin-1/2 Heisenberg model on the pyrochlore lattice, Eq. (1) at lambda = 1, j2 = 0 (H = j1 sum S_i · S_j with spin operators), j1 = 1, periodic 4 x 3^3 cluster.
